item.title: Guangzhou DoubleTree by Hilton — Seafood Hotpot Buffet from ¥188
item.description:
Deal price: ¥188 (≈$26) for 1 adult + 1 kid lunch · 1 adult + 1 kid dinner ¥288 (≈$40) · 2 adults + 2 kids lunch ¥338 (≈$47) · 2 adults + 2 kids dinner ¥498 (≈$69) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

DoubleTree by Hilton Guangzhou (Dongfeng Middle Road, Yuexiu) runs a seafood hotpot–themed buffet where you can have it both ways: pile up salmon, iced seafood, fresh sashimi, Häagen-Dazs and German beer — or drop ingredients into your own little hotpot right at the table. Dinner also comes with signature served dishes brought to your seat.

item.title: Shanghai Chunfeng Campsite — All-You-Can-Eat Outdoor BBQ from ¥39.9 (Kids)
item.description:
Deal price: ¥39.9 (≈$5.50) kids early-bird · Adult early-bird ¥88 (≈$12) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

Chunfeng Campsite runs two outdoor BBQ campsites in Shanghai — Chunfeng Heyuan in Minhang (Luheng Road) and Chunfeng Jiayuan in Jiading (Jiabei Country Park) — and this early-bird ticket is an all-you-can-eat BBQ with 30+ ingredients, plus a pile of free playground games for the kids. A great National Day outdoor option.

item.title: Xiamen Beihaiwan — 'Crayfish Festival' Buffet, 1 Adult + 1 Kid from ¥118 (+ Free Playground Ticket)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥118 (≈$16) for 1 adult + 1 kid (lunch) · 2 adults + 2 kids lunch ¥216 (≈$30) · Dinner from ¥138 (≈$19) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The Beihaiwan Howard Johnson Wanda Plaza (Jimei District, Xiamen — ranked among the city’s Top 10 family resorts) is running a “Crayfish Festival” themed buffet, and the crayfish situation is gloriously over the top: 10+ flavors, all-you-can-eat, made fresh to order — iced/chilled crayfish, spicy, garlic, curry, steamed, braised, thirteen-spice, tom yum, bo-bo chicken style, even crayfish nigiri and hand rolls. Beyond the crayfish stations there’s chilled seafood, live grilling, a sushi bar, hot dishes and dozens of desserts (guests rave about the dessert spread enough to call it “an afternoon tea after the buffet”).

item.title: HNA Westin Guangzhou — 'Fish & Crab Feast' Buffet, 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥348
item.description:
Deal price: family packages from ¥348 (≈$48) for 2 adults + 2 kids · Child-only tickets from ¥108 (≈$15) · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The Guangzhou HNA Westin (Linhe Middle Road, Tianhe District) has launched a “Fish & Crab Feast” themed buffet. The headline upgrades land on weekends: Saturday–Sunday lunch guests each get a complimentary Buddha-Jumps-Over-the-Wall (with abalone, dried scallops and sea cucumber in a sweet, rich broth), while weekend dinner adds a hairy crab per seat plus a live band. Weekend lunches also run kids’ themed activities, and lunch comes with free-flow beer and soft drinks (dinner adds red and white wine). Usable even during the National Day holiday week, refundable anytime, and 70+ packages already grabbed.
